conflict_synopsis.core_view: The verified CA-US 2Y carry of about 140bp is paid in long USDCAD and the energy/CAD narrative is not large enough to overwhelm that holding cost.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Delivered Fed hike plus near-2% Canadian core keeps the 140bp CA-US 2Y differential intact after the oil-supply tail was reduced.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: BoC hikes or the Fed eases enough to compress CA-US 2Y, or an energy-supply shock reopens a CAD ToT tail that overwhelms carry.

remit: positive carry and patient expressions unless a catalyst overwhelms it
stance_summary: Own the verified US–CA 2Y carry in patient long USDCAD; reject long-CAD energy narratives that require paying 140bp and reject stretched AUD crosses whose housing/energy catalysts overwhelm the extra carry.

catalysts: Delivered Fed 25bp hike with August CPI keeping tightening bias intact
Canada core inflation near 2% limits an immediate BoC catch-up hike
Saudi Oman workaround reducing the extreme oil-supply tail
Global tightening broadening after the Fed move
trade.horizon: 2-4 months patient hold, collecting the 2Y differential unless energy/BoC pass-through overwhelms
trade.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if the CA–US 2Y carry proxy compresses because BoC hikes on energy pass-through or the Fed enters an easing cycle, or if an energy-supply shock reopens an extreme oil tail.
trade.mispricing: Market pricing already embeds a historically wide USD yield premium over CAD, but USDCAD spot has not matched that 5y-percentile extremity. The implied assumption in fading USDCAD is that CAD energy pass-through or a Fed pivot will close the 140bp gap fast enough to beat carry.
principal_risks: Energy shock absorbers remain weak and crude-near-$110 can reassert CAD ToT
BoC minutes already flag higher energy pass-through
No forward points, OIS, or executable broker prices
trade.structure: spot FX; official 2Y yield differential is the carry proxy because forward points and OIS are not in the packet
trade.thesis: The economically relevant carry in the frozen packet is the common-date CA–US 2Y spread of -140bp as of 2026-09-17: long USD versus short CAD is paid about 140bp annualized on the sovereign 2Y proxy. The Fed has already delivered 25bp to 3.75–4.00% while Canada’s headline 3% inflation coexists with core near 2%. Carry improves the holding-period distribution if the energy/CAD terms-of-trade story does not overwhelm. AUDCAD would pay more but is already at a 5y extreme while Australian housing is transmitting tighter policy. NZ yields are unavailable, so AUDNZD carry cannot be quantified and is refused.
why_now: Fed hike to 3.75–4.00% is in the rear-view and August CPI keeps the tightening bias intact.
CA–US 2Y is -140bp on 2026-09-17, 1y percentile 3.77 and 5y percentile 4.30, after further widening.
Canada August inflation holds at 3% with core near 2%, so BoC energy-pass-through risk is a tail, not a delivered hike.
Saudi workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail that could overwhelm USD–CAD carry.
